messages:
Maya (eng-runtime): heads up — after we turned on the new greedy routing policy yesterday we've seen a bump in tool-call schema rejections (~2.8% -> 8.9%). suspecting truncated model outputs due to quota + routing combos. sample req id: rq_0a9f3c

Liam - eng-platform: can you paste a concrete example payload / log? is it limited to one model variant or region?

Maya (eng-runtime): example from logs: 
```
request_id: rq_0a9f3c
model_variant: gptx-4f-quant
route: greedy-eu
region: eu-west-1
status: response_sent
tokens_out: 490
last_bytes: "...\n### TOOL_RESULT: {\"status\":\"ok\", \"items\":[{\"id\":1,\"val\":\"foo\"}]\n"
error: schema_parse_error: unexpected_eof
```
Output got cut right in the JSON blob (missing closing braces).

Jon P: ugh that looks like a hard truncation mid-stream. remember we enforce per-route max_tokens_per_response for certain tiers — if router drops the stream when quota hit you get invalid JSON. also continuous batching + kernel preemption can finish earlier.

Rita (product): is this mostly hitting paid customers on bursty routes or internal canaries? product needs to know user impact before we show this in console.

Maya (eng-runtime): majority is on routes that were set to "greedy" fallback to cheaper variants. Most affected: eu greedy pool + dev-tier routes. A couple of enterprise customers saw failed tool calls in their integrations.

Vikram S: telemetry proposal: add a dimensioned counter for toolcall_schema_rejects labeled by reason (truncated|invalid_json|type_mismatch), route, model_variant, and quota_bucket. Example prometheus-ish query: 
```
sum(rate(redwood_toolcall_schema_rejects[5m])) by (reason, route, model_variant)
```
Also capture last_chunk_size histogram so we can correlate small final chunks with truncations.

Liam - eng-platform: agreed on telemetry. Also thinking about a router change: avoid enforcing mid-stream hard cutoffs — instead mark the response as "soft-cut" and let the stream finish but append a sentinel so schema parsers can detect partial. But that may cost tokens.

Jon P: implementation-wise we can add a post-stream hook to ensure bracket-balancing for top-level JSON outputs when tool calling is enabled. Two options: server-side ensure-complete-json wrapper (attempt to request extra tokens to close JSON) OR SDK-side lenient parser with retry. Server-side is safer for webhooks.

Rita (product): for Console UX: surface a per-route metric called "tool_call_schema_rejection_rate" (5m/1h) and a note about likely causes (quota, routing fallback, model variants). Add a rollouts panel that flags routes with >5% regression after policy changes. Also expose a toggle: "Prefer completeness over cost for tool calls (avoid mid-stream cut)".

Vikram S: +1. For telemetry we should also emit an event with the last 2-4 tokens (sanitized) to help debug exactly where truncation occurs. label the event with rollout_id so we can slice by routing policy.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback v2026.03.routing -> v2026.02 reduced toolcall schema rejects in eu by ~67% within 30m: https://dash.redwood/c/anomaly/78

Liam - eng-platform: good catch. short-term mitigation: rollback greedy routing to relaxed policy for affected customers and bump max_tokens_per_response for tool-call routes. mid-term: implement soft-cut + ensure-complete-json wrapper and the telemetry counters Vikram proposed.

Maya (eng-runtime): I'll open a short RFC capturing: 1) telemetry labels + prometheus queries, 2) router soft-cut behavior + implementation notes, 3) Console UX mocks (metric + toggle + rollout flag). Assigning to Vikram and Jon to own infra pieces.

Jon P: I'll spike the post-stream bracket-balancer and measure the extra token cost. estimate 1-2% token increase for affected routes but should reduce customer error noise.

Vikram S: I'll add metrics and the event schema (with rollout_id, route, reason, truncated_bytes_base64). will also add Grafana panel prototype.

Rita (product): thanks — once RFC is up we'll decide rollout cadence. product wants an A/B where we keep cost-trimmed variant on by default but show an opt-in "ensure-complete-json" for customers with tool-call integrations.

Liam - eng-platform: one more ask — add an alert rule: if tool_call_schema_rejection_rate increases >3ppt in 15m post-rollout, auto-pause routing policy rollouts and notify eng-platform on-call.

Maya (eng-runtime): noted. I'll ping ops and create the RFC PR in repo infra/rfcs/184-toolcall-completeness.md

Jon P: thanks — will also add unit tests to schema validator to simulate mid-token truncation.

Rita (product): :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reaction :thumbsup: to Maya (eng-runtime)
